$comment: 语法大厅 G37（V0.9 P3 进阶层，从句家族收官）。比喻锚点：整段当主奏上台。只讲初中层面（what/that/whether 主语从句、表语从句、谓语单数、It 形式主语、台前不用 if），不堆砌复杂例外；多重从句拆解留给精修层 G48。全部内容原创。
title: 主语从句与表语从句
ketNote: 老实说：KET 不考主语从句，A2 只要求看懂 It is said that... 这类常见开头。这是初中和 PET 的内容——这课为它打底，学到就是赚到，不用焦虑。

sections.essence: 一整段当主语或表语上台：语序坐正，谓语按单数，头重就请 It 占位。
sections.why: G33 里一整段话坐进了宾语座位；这一课它走到台前——当主语（主奏），或站在 be 后面当表语。中文毫无压力：「他说的都是真话」，「的」字一打包就能当主语。英语也行——What he said is true——但英语有个执念：讨厌头重脚轻。主语太长，观众等半天等不到动词，于是英语发明了占位符 It：让 It 先站上主奏位报幕，真正的大段挪到句尾——It is true that he never lies。另外两条纪律：整段算「一件事」，谓语按单数；台前的「是不是」必须穿正装 whether，if 上不了主语的台。初中和 PET 常考；KET 只要求看懂 It is said that...。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队的新曲把一整段合唱放在开头当主角。首演时观众听了半天合唱，迟迟等不到主歌，都开始看表。指挥想了个办法：派一个小小的引子先站上主奏位报幕——它自己不含任何旋律，只说「正主稍后登场」——然后把大段合唱挪到曲子后半。这个引子就是 It：It is amazing that the whole choir sings as one。学徒问：「大段当主奏时，鼓手按几个人打拍子？」指挥说：「一整段算一件事——按单数打。」又问：「要是这段从『是不是』开始呢？」「站台前要穿正装 whether——if 那件便装只能在后台的宾语座位穿（G33）。」

cards.detail: what / that / whether 领起的一整段坐上主语位。
cards.example: What he said is true. / That she won surprised everyone.

cards.rule: 表语从句：整段站在 be 后面
cards.detail: 说明主语「是什么/为什么/是不是」，that / why / whether 开场。
cards.example: The problem is that we have no time. / That's why I came.

cards.rule: 谓语按单数：整段算一件事
cards.detail: 不管段里有多少名词，整段只算一件事——is / was / makes。
cards.example: What we need is more practice.

cards.rule: It 占位：头重脚轻的解药
cards.detail: 主语太长就让 It 站台前报幕，真主语挪到句尾。
cards.example: It is said that ... / It is important that ...

cards.detail: 主语从句开头的「是不是」必须用 whether；if 只在宾语座位通用。
cards.example: Whether he will come is not clear.（✗ If he will come is ...）

cards.detail: 台前的整段和宾语从句一样，一律陈述语序（G33 同一条纪律）。
cards.example: What he did（✗ What did he do）made everyone laugh.

basic.cn: 他说的话是真的。（what 段当主语）

basic.en: That's why I love this song.
basic.cn: 这就是我爱这首歌的原因。（why 段当表语）

basic.en: It is said that the singer will come to our city.
basic.cn: 据说那位歌手要来我们市。（It 占位）

basic.en: The problem is that we have no time.
What you need is a good rest.
basic.cn: 你需要的是好好休息一下。

mid.en: Whether he will join us is not clear yet.
mid.cn: 他会不会加入还不清楚。（台前穿 whether）

mid.en: It is clear that she has practised a lot.
mid.cn: 显然她下了很多功夫练习。

mid.en: The question is whether we can finish in time.
mid.cn: 问题是我们能不能按时完成。

mid.en: What surprised me most was the ending of the story.
mid.cn: 最让我吃惊的是故事的结局。

mid.en: That's because the tickets were sold out.

trap.en: What we need is more practice.
trap.cn: 我们需要的是更多练习。
trap.note: 整段算一件事——谓语 is 用单数，别被 more practice 带偏。

trap.en: Whether it will rain doesn't matter.
trap.note: 台前不用 if——「是不是」站句首要穿 whether。

trap.en: It is said that music helps memory.
trap.note: It 只是占位报幕——真主语是 that 后面那一整段。

trap.en: What he did made everyone laugh.
trap.cn: 他做的事把大家逗笑了。
trap.note: 台前的整段照样坐正——What he did，不是 What did he do。

trap.en: The truth is that nobody checked the door.
trap.note: 表语位置的 that 习惯保留——别学宾语从句随手省掉。

trap.en: That she won first prize made us proud.
trap.cn: 她得了一等奖让我们骄傲。
trap.note: 陈述段当主语时 that 不能省——它是开场记号。

redBlack.bad: Is important that you come early.（想说：你早点来很重要）
redBlack.good: It is important that you come early.
redBlack.why: 英语的主奏位不能空着——It 占位报幕，句子才立得住；空着开场，听的人不知道谁在台上。

redBlack.bad: What did he say is not important.（想说：他说了什么不重要）
redBlack.good: What he said is not important.
redBlack.why: 台前的整段也要坐正——倒装一混进来，听的人以为你在提问，整句散架。

redBlack.bad: If he will come is not clear.
redBlack.good: Whether he will come is not clear.
redBlack.why: 主语从句台前不用 if——「是不是」要穿正装 whether。

redBlack.bad: What we need are more practice.
redBlack.good: What we need is more practice.
redBlack.why: 整段算一件事——谓语按单数。

redBlack.bad: It said that the show will start at seven.
redBlack.good: It is said that the show will start at seven.
redBlack.why: 「据说」是 It is said that——be 不能丢（G29 的被动两件套）。

redBlack.bad: That is why did she leave early.
redBlack.good: That is why she left early.
redBlack.why: 表语从句照样坐正——did 退场，过去式回到 left。

redBlack.bad: She won first prize made us proud.
redBlack.good: That she won first prize made us proud.
redBlack.why: 陈述段当主语要有 that 开场——不能裸奔，否则两个谓语撞车。

redBlack.bad: The question is that we can finish in time.（想说：能不能按时完成）
redBlack.good: The question is whether we can finish in time.
redBlack.why: 「能不能」是「是不是」类——用 whether；that 只接确定的陈述。

redBlack.bad: Whether will he agree is unknown.
redBlack.good: Whether he will agree is unknown.
redBlack.why: whether 领路后照样坐正——will 回到主语后面。

redBlack.bad: That's because of he missed the bus.
redBlack.good: That's because he missed the bus.
redBlack.why: because 接句子；because of 只接名词——表语从句用 because + 句子。

redBlack.bad: The problem is we have no time.（有人说必须补 that）
redBlack.good: 口语常省，书面加 that 更稳。
redBlack.why: 表语从句省 that 口语里常见——不挡意思；考试写作补上更稳妥。

redBlack.bad: It is said that ... 与 People say that ...（有人说只有一种对）
redBlack.why: 「据说」的两副面孔可以互换——不挡意思不设坑。

contrast.cn: 他说的都是真话。（「的」字打包当主语）
contrast.diff: 中文靠「的」打包；英语靠 what / that 领队上台。

contrast.cn: 你来不来无所谓。（正反并列当主语）
contrast.en: Whether you come or not doesn't matter.
contrast.diff: 中文用「来不来」；英语台前穿 whether——if 上不了主语的台。

contrast.cn: 据说他要来。（两个字开场）
contrast.en: It is said that he is coming.
contrast.diff: 中文「据说」两字搞定；英语派 It 占位再加被动 is said。

contrast.cn: 重要的是坚持。（头重不头重无所谓）
contrast.en: It is important that we keep going.
contrast.diff: 英语讨厌头重脚轻——大段后移，It 报幕。

contrast.cn: 问题是我们没时间。（直接往下说）
contrast.en: The problem is that we have no time.
contrast.diff: 英语表语从句要 that 开场；中文什么都不用加。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 整段上台先坐正；一段算一件，谓语单；头重请 It，台前 whether。
steps: 认出台前的整段：what / that / whether 领起的一段坐在主语位，或站在 be 后面当表语。
坐正：段内一律陈述语序（G33 同一条纪律）。
谓语按单数：一整段算一件事——is / was / makes。
头重脚轻？请 It 占位：It is said / important / clear that ...。
台前的「是不是」穿 whether——if 只在宾语座位通用。
陈述段当主语时 that 不能省——它是开场记号。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩『……的是……』造句：我问『你最喜欢的是什么』，你用英语回答，开头必须是 What——What I like best is drawing. 我不懂英语没关系，我只听两件事：句子开头是不是 What、That、Whether 这几个音；中间那个 be 是不是单数的 is——整段话算一件事，就一个 is。」再玩一轮「据说」：让孩子用 It is said that... 转述三件趣闻——听听开头有没有 It is 两个音，少了 is 我就喊『报幕员迟到』。最后考一句：「他会不会来还不知道」——看孩子开头用的是 whether 还是 if。
questions: 「我们需要的是休息」——What we need 后面为什么用 is 不用 are？
It is said that he will come. 里的 It 是「它」吗？真正的主语是哪段？
「他会不会来还不清楚」开头为什么不能用 If？

sections.echo: 从句四课到此集齐：宾语座位（G33）、装饰音（G34）、舞台提示（G35/G36）、台前主奏（G37）——四个位置，一套通则：坐正、对表、一句一个领队。位置在变，纪律不变，这正是英语从句的规律性。而 It 占位，是英语「主奏位永远不能空」这条铁律的产物——连「下雨了」都得说 It rains（G04 见过的老朋友）。最常用的小词 it 因此攒下一堆职务：真代词、天气官、占位报幕员——越常用的词，职务越多，规律与例外仍是一体两面。几种从句叠在一个长句里怎么拆，留给精修层 G48（长难句拆解）。

stages.name: 认一认 · 台前的整段

questions.q: What he said is true. 这句的主语是？
questions.explain: what 领起的整段坐上了主语位。

questions.q: 主语从句指的是？
questions.explain: 整段旋律当主奏。

questions.q: 表语从句常站在哪个词后面？
questions.explain: The problem is that ...——be 后面那一段。

questions.q: 整段当主语时，谓语用？
questions.explain: 一整段算一件事——按单数。

questions.q: 「是不是」开头的主语从句用哪个词？
questions.explain: 台前穿正装 whether；if 上不了主语的台。

questions.q: It is said that he will come. 真正的主语是？
options: that he will come 那一整段
questions.explain: It 只是占位——正主在句尾。

questions.q: It is important that... 里的 It 是？
options: 占位的报幕员（形式主语）
questions.explain: It 自己不含内容，只替长主语占位。

questions.q: What you need ___ a good rest. 填？
questions.explain: 整段算一件事——is。

questions.q: 主语从句里的语序要？
questions.explain: 和宾语从句同一条纪律（G33）。

questions.q: The problem is ___ we have no time. 填？
questions.explain: 确定的陈述——that 开场。

questions.q: 「你来不来无所谓」的开头是？
questions.explain: 台前的「是不是」——Whether。

questions.q: That she won the prize made us proud. 开头的 That 能省吗？
questions.explain: 省了它，两个谓语就撞车了。

questions.q: 英语为什么发明 It 占位？
options: 讨厌头重脚轻——大段主语后移
questions.explain: 观众不用等半天才听到动词。

questions.q: That's why I was late. 里 why I was late 是？
questions.explain: 站在 is 后面——表语从句。

questions.q: 「据说」常用哪个句型？
questions.explain: It 占位 + 被动 is said（G29）。

questions.q: 下面哪句包含主语从句？
options: What surprised me was the ending.
I was surprised at the ending.
questions.explain: What surprised me 整段当主语。

stages.name: 选一选 · 请对报幕员

questions.q: ___ he said at the meeting is true.
questions.explain: 「他说的话」——What 段当主语。

questions.q: ___ he will join us is not clear yet.
questions.explain: 台前的「是不是」——Whether。

questions.q: It is said ___ the singer will come to our city.
questions.explain: It is said that ...——陈述内容。

questions.q: The question is ___ we can finish in time.
questions.explain: 「能不能」——whether。

questions.q: What surprised me most ___ the ending of the story.
questions.explain: 整段算一件事——was。

questions.q: ___ is important that everyone comes on time.
questions.explain: It 占位报幕——真主语在句尾。

questions.q: The truth is ___ nobody checked the door.
questions.explain: 确定的陈述——that。

questions.q: What we need ___ more practice.
questions.explain: 谓语按单数——is。

questions.q: ___ she won first prize made her parents proud.
questions.explain: 完整陈述段当主语——That 开场不能省。

questions.q: That's ___ I love this song — it tells my story.
questions.explain: 这就是原因——That's why ...。

questions.q: It is clear ___ she has practised a lot.
questions.explain: It is clear that ...。

questions.q: ___ you say sorry or not doesn't matter now.
questions.explain: or not 配 whether——台前更是如此。

questions.q: — Why are you so happy? — That's ___ our team won.
questions.explain: 回答原因——That's because ...。

questions.q: What makes this band special ___ their real stories.
questions.explain: 整段算一件事——is。

questions.q: ___ is a pity that you missed the show.
questions.explain: It is a pity that ...——It 占位。

questions.q: The good news is ___ the tickets are free.
questions.explain: 好消息的内容是陈述——that。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（他说的话不重要）
options: What he said is not important.
What did he say is not important.
What he said are not important.
questions.explain: 坐正 + 谓语单数。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（他会不会来还不清楚）
options: Whether he will come is not clear.
If he will come is not clear.
Whether will he come is not clear.
questions.explain: 台前穿 whether，后面照样坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（据说演出七点开始）
options: It is said that the show starts at seven.
It said that the show starts at seven.
It is said whether the show starts at seven.
questions.explain: It is said that——be 不能丢。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（我们需要的是更多练习）
options: What we need is more practice.
What we need are more practice.
What do we need is more practice.
questions.explain: 整段算一件事 is；段内坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（她获奖让我们骄傲）
options: That she won the prize made us proud.
She won the prize made us proud.
What she won the prize made us proud.
questions.explain: 陈述段当主语要 That 开场。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（问题是我们能不能按时完成）
options: The question is whether we can finish on time.
The question is that we can finish on time.
The question is whether can we finish on time.
questions.explain: 「能不能」用 whether，从句坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（这就是她早退的原因）
options: That is why she left early.
That is why did she leave early.
That is because of she left early.
questions.explain: why 段坐正；because of 不接句子。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（重要的是别放弃）
options: It is important that we don't give up.
Is important that we don't give up.
It important that we don't give up.
questions.explain: It 占位 + is 都不能少。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（让我惊讶的是结局）
options: What surprised me was the ending.
What surprised me were the ending.
What did surprise me was the ending.
questions.explain: 整段单数 was；段内坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（你说不说实话很关键）
options: Whether you tell the truth is important.
If you tell the truth is important.
Whether do you tell the truth is important.
questions.explain: 台前 whether + 坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（真相是没人锁门）
options: The truth is that nobody locked the door.
The truth is that nobody locked it the door.
The truth is what nobody locked the door.
questions.explain: that 开场；不重复代词。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（很遗憾你错过了演出）
options: It is a pity that you missed the show.
It is a pity what you missed the show.
Is a pity that you missed the show.
questions.explain: It is a pity that ...——It 与 is 都在场。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（那是因为他起晚了）
options: That's because he got up late.
That's because of he got up late.
That's because did he get up late.
questions.explain: because + 句子；坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（谁来当队长还没定）
options: Who will be the captain hasn't been decided.
Who will be the captain haven't been decided.
Will who be the captain hasn't been decided.
questions.explain: who 段当主语——单数 hasn't；段内坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（好消息是门票免费）
options: The good news is that the tickets are free.
The good news is whether the tickets are free.
The good news is that are the tickets free.
questions.explain: 确定内容用 that；从句坐正。

questions.q: 哪一句台风正？（据说音乐能帮助记忆）
options: It is said that music helps memory.
It said that music helps memory.
It is said that music help memory.
questions.explain: It is said that + music helps（三单）。

questions.q: 两空：___ the concert will be held outside ___ on the weather.
questions.explain: 台前 Whether；整段单数 depends。

questions.q: 大考：___ is amazing ___ the whole choir sings as one.
questions.explain: It 占位报幕，真主语是 that 段。

questions.q: ___ we saw at the museum made us think a lot.
questions.explain: 「我们看到的东西」——What 段当主语。

questions.q: The best part of the trip was ___ we watched the sunrise together.
questions.explain: 表语从句陈述内容——that。

questions.q: 两空：___ he failed doesn't matter; ___ matters is that he tried.
questions.explain: That he failed 当主语；what matters 当主语。

questions.q: It is well known ___ practice makes progress.
questions.explain: 众所周知——It is well known that。

questions.q: 找错：哪句的开头穿错了衣服？
options: If she will agree is still a question.
Whether she will agree is still a question.
I don't know if she will agree.
questions.explain: 台前不用 if；第三句 if 在宾语座位合法（G33）。

questions.q: What the band needs most ___ new songs, not new clothes.
questions.explain: 整段算一件事——is。

questions.q: 两空：___ is strange ___ the lights were still on at midnight.
questions.explain: It is strange that ...。

questions.q: — Why is the hall so quiet? — That's ___ the exam has started.
questions.explain: 回答原因——That's because。

questions.q: He got full marks. That's ___ he practised all month.
questions.explain: 满分的原因是苦练——That's because。

questions.q: ___ we go by train or by bus makes little difference.
questions.explain: 「坐火车还是大巴」的两可——Whether 上台。

questions.q: It is reported ___ the new hall will open next spring.
questions.explain: It is reported that——报道说。

questions.q: 两空：The fact is ___ nobody knows ___ the old song came from.
questions.explain: 表语 that；里面再套一个 where 的宾语从句。

questions.q: 找错：哪句谓语用错了？
options: What I want for dinner are noodles.
What I want for dinner is noodles.
Noodles are what I want for dinner.
questions.explain: what 段当主语按单数 is；第三句主语是 noodles，用 are 没错。

questions.q: 大考二：___ is said ___ the singer once lived here, but ___ it is true is hard to prove.
questions.explain: It is said that ...；whether it is true 整段当主语。

detective.sentence: If he will come to the party is not clear.
detective.fixed: Whether he will come to the party is not clear.
detective.clue: 主语从句台前不用 if——「是不是」要穿正装 whether。

detective.sentence: What we need are more time.
detective.fixed: What we need is more time.
detective.clue: 整段算一件事——谓语用单数 is。

detective.sentence: Is said that the band will play here next month.
detective.fixed: It is said that the band will play here next month.
detective.clue: 主奏位不能空——It 占位报幕。

detective.sentence: What did she cook smells wonderful.
detective.clue: 台前的整段也要坐正——did 退场，过去式回到动词。

detective.sentence: The problem is that can we get enough chairs.
detective.fixed: The problem is whether we can get enough chairs.
detective.clue: 「能不能」用 whether，从句还要坐正。

detective.sentence: She passed the test made her parents happy.
detective.fixed: That she passed the test made her parents happy.
detective.clue: 陈述段当主语要有 that 开场——不能裸奔。

detective.sentence: That's because of he forgot the time.
detective.fixed: That's because he forgot the time.
detective.clue: because 接句子；because of 只接名词。
